text.p: Shares in two junior Canadian mining companies continued to climb on Monday, extending last week's gains on assay results from Francisco Gold Corp's El Sauzai gold property in Mexico.
Queenstake Resources Ltd's stock was up 0.29 at 3.85 in heavy late afternoon turnover of 4.25 million shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

Francisco's stock jumped 0.95 to 31.95 on 501,000 shares on the Vancouver Stock Exchange. Queenstake's Yecorato 51 property is completely surrounded by Francisco's El Sauzai property which yielded promising assay results on Friday.
"It's got a lot to do with the new gold discovery. It's just extending (Friday's rally)," one stock analyst said.
Francisco made a preliminary geological resource estimate on Friday of 3.2 million ounces of gold at an average grade of 3.8 grams per tonne gold for the El Sauzai property.
